content: A S equence Counter ( SC ) of 4 bit is representing numbers from 0 to 15 per Time Domain . The Sequence Counter shall be independent between SYNC and OF S messages and shall be incremented by 1 continuously on every transmission request of a SYNC or OFS message . It shall wrap around at 15 to 0 again.
